content: Ulamukilu kwaka mundu jumu jumu
Mbala kummanyiha kwinu ndombu witu Foibe, joabhi mtumika wa likanisa lelibhi ku Kenkilea,

nahuli munjopalya kwa lihina laka Bambo, ngati moibhapalaki bhandu bhaka Chapanga. Munjangatyaje kwa lilobhi lokapi lela leanapala kuhuma kwinu, maghambu najombi abhi njangatila kwa bhandu bhamaheli, na kwangu nepani.
Mwalamukya Pulisila na Akila, bhahenga lihengu papamu na nepani mu utumika waka Kristo Yesu.
Bhombi bhakabhi tayali hata kuhobheha womi wabhu kwa ndandi jangu, ambabhu nabhachengula, kabheti nga nepani pela, nambu na makanisa ghokapi gha bhandu bha mataifa ghangi.
Mulilamukya kabheti likanisa lelihimangana mu nyumba jabhu. Mundamukya nkochi wangu mpalu Epaineto, joabhi wa kutumbula ku mkoa wa Asia kunhobhalela Kristo.
Mundamukya Malia, joakahengiki lihengu namaa kwa ndandi jinu.
Mwalamukya Andiloniko na Yunia, Bhayahude bhajangu bhabhakongakiki muchifungo papamu na nepani, bhombi bhamanyikana namaa pachilanda ja mitumi, na bhombi bhakabhi muka Kristo mangane jangu nepani.
Mundamukya Ampiliato, nkochi wangu mpalu mu kulombana na Bambo.
Mundamukya Ulubano, muhenga lihengu njangu mu utumika waka Kristo, bhelabhela nundamukila Stakisi, nkochi wangu mpalu.
Mundamukya Apele joakabhi ndongwana kwaka Kristo. Mwalamukya bhokapi bhabhabhi munyumba jaka Alistobulo.
Mundamukya Helodioni, Myahude njangu. Mwalamukya bhandu bhabhabhi munyumba jaka Nalikiso, bhabhunhobhale Bambo.
Mwalamukya Tilifaina na Tilifosa, akambomba bhabhahenga lihengu laka Bambo. Mundamukya Pelisisi, mbomba jongi joakahengiki mambu ghamaheli kwa ndandi jaka Bambo.
Mundamukya Lufo, muhaghulika waka Bambo, na mabhu waki, joabhi mabhu wangu bhelabhela.
Mundamukya Asinkilito, na Filegoni, na Helime, na Patiloba, na Helima, na bhalongu bhabhabhi papamu nabhu.
Mundamukya Filologo na Yulia, Nelea na ndombu waki, Olimpa na bhahuhu bhokapi bhabhabhi papamu nabhu.
Ndamukanyaje kwa nginyulila ja upalu. Makanisa ghokapi ghaka Kristo ghundamukila.
Malaghalakilu gha kujomukela
Bhalongu bhangu, numpwaghila, mubhalingalya bhandu bhala bhabhaleta ulekanganu na kubheka mambu gha ihibhalakilu kihanganyuma cha mabholu ghamulibholike, na mlijepa nabhu.
Kwa ndandi bhandu bhabhabhi bhenibhela ngachebhuntumakila Bambo witu Kristo, nambu matumbu ghabhu bhene, na kwa malobhi ghaghanogha na malobhi gha kupembalakela bhajikoloha mitima ja bhandu bhambone.

Kwa ndandi kila mundu ajowini panani ja kutii kwinu kwa kutenda mambu ghambone. Bhela nanatu nhekalela kwa ndandi jinu, nambu mbala mwehapa mbya na mbulau kwa mambu manyahi, na bhanga na hatia kwa mambu mahakau.
Najombi Chapanga wa lukwali anaantimba Shetani pahi ja magholu ghinu manyata. Chihomu chaka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo chibya papamu na mwehapa. Amina.
Timoseo, muhenga lihengu papamu na nepani andamukila, andamukila na Lukio, na Yasoni, na Sosipatilo, bhalongu bhangu, bhundamukila.
Nepani nde Tetio, nenembiki baluwa jenu, nundamukila kwa lihina laka Bambo.
Gayo, mwenehi wangu, papamu na likanisa lelihimangana panyumba jaki, andamukila. Elasto, joatunza mbija ya muchi, na Kwalito, ndongu witu, bhundamukila.
Chihomu chaka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo chibya papamu na mwehapa mabhokapi. Amina.
Malobhu gha kundumbalila Chapanga

Henu na alumbalikaje Chapanga, joaweza kunhenga kukangamala kupetela Malobhi Manyahi ghandangaza panani jaka Yesu Kristo, kulengana na sili jejiyekuliwi na ambaju jakabhi jihiyakiki kutumbu pamwandi hapa.
Nambu sajenu chakaka heji jiyekuliwi kwa indela ja Malembu gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga, na kwa amuli jaka Chapanga wa mileli, imanyakini kwa inchi yokapi nahuli bhokapi bhaweza kuhobhalela na kutii.
Kwaki Chapanga joabhi na mbulau kanjika jaki. Ulumbalilu ubya najombi kupetela kwaka Yesu Kristo mileli na mileli! Amina.
